name: Phuchka (Golgappa)
instructions: 1. Mix semolina and whole wheat flour with water to form a firm dough, roll into tiny discs, and deep-fry until golden and puffed.
2. Prepare the filling by mashing boiled potatoes and mixing them with boiled black chickpeas, roasted cumin, black salt, and chopped coriander.
3. Create the 'teekha pani' by mixing tamarind pulp, water, green chili paste, crushed mint, cumin powder, and black salt to taste.
4. Crack open the center of each shell, stuff with a spoonful of the potato mixture, and dip into the spicy tamarind water before serving immediately.
description: Phuchka is a quintessential street food icon in Jharkhand, known for being bolder and spicier than its counterparts in other regions. It is a social ritual, where friends and family gather around a 'phuchka-wala' cart to enjoy the explosion of tangy, spicy, and crunchy flavors.
